description:
READ-ONLY. Before a MAJOR upgrade, tell the operator how hard each NON-core (custom/OCA) add-on
    will be to carry across - the missing half of an upgrade (OpenUpgrade/the platform migrate the DB
    + CORE, never third-party add-on code). For every installed non-core module it scans the module's
    OWN source for a catalogue of real 17->18->19 breaking-change signatures (the <tree>->_<list>_
    rename, res.groups losing category_id, removed core fields like sale.order.analytic_account_id,
    the stock.location.route->stock.route rename, `super()._check_name()` now hitting a declarative
    Constraint, moved res.partner/res.users view anchors, removed xml ids, post_init hooks, JS/asset
    bundles…) and classifies each module: `clean` (manifest bump only) / `auto` (mechanical) / `assist`
    (known small code fix) / `manual` (needs a human - usually UI-only, so never block DATA on it).
    Nothing is modified. Pair with migrate_server.upgrade_assess (which sizes the CORE upgrade).
    `target_major` defaults to current+1.
name: addon_migrate_assess
